monitor:
MEMORY
 B0-3
 D addr [end]
 M addr bytes
 F addr bytes
 G addr
 L

MAPS
 M [1 grid|2 ranges|3 wear]

FLASH
 I start end
 W
 U A|B

STORAGE
 S bank flash start end [label]
 R [bank] label|bank flash [L]
 T [bank|first-last]

BOOT
 J0-3
 C [0|1 bank addr|V delay]
 P [A|B]
extension:
PROGRAMS
 APPS       List installed programs
 R MAINT    Restore saved maintenance

L loads S19; W shows wear; U updates a slot.
M edits RAM; F edits flash.
C: startup settings; P: boot preference.
Numbers: hex. []: optional.
